name: first-timers

schema.description: A bot that helps onboarding new open-source contributors.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Sets the labels if "first-timers-only" is not what you are looking for.

template.title: Template
template.description: The path to your template, relative from the repository root.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: Specify a different repository than where the problem is. The bot must be installed on the configured repository.

schema.title: first-timers-bot

description:
Hi team,

The first‑timers bot has been set up for the repository **example-org/example-repo**. It will pull the issue template from **.github/first-timers-template.md** whenever a newcomer opens a new issue.

For labeling, the bot will automatically attach the tags **good first issue**, **help wanted**, and **first-timers-only** to help surface suitable tasks for new contributors.
